create_agent_memory: create an AgentMemory instance with an in-process SQLite database and schema initialization
add_triple: add a subject-predicate-object triple to the triplestore with optional confidence score
tag_memory: tag a memory node with a text label using the has_tag predicate
get_triples: query triples from the triplestore by subject, predicate, or object filters
task_stack_push: push a new Task onto the task stack with optional parent task and chat effect
